data.long_meaning: Feminine of saʿīd, from the Arabic root س-ع-د (s-ʿ-d), 'to be fortunate'. Its root is س-ع-د (s-ʿ-d). A common Muslim female name. Sadia is a Arabic name meaning “Fortunate; lucky; happy”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sadia total 16, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
